claims.head: Shots should fly both ways
claims.call: The game runs at more than 84.4 shots per 60 at 5-on-5, faster than either team’s usual.
claims.body: Nashville plays some of the league’s fastest games, and so does Toronto. We think this one runs hotter than either team’s usual.
claims.nums: Pace (shots per 60 at 5-on-5, both teams): Nashville 4th (84.4), Toronto 5th (84.4)
claims.gist: Both teams like a fast game.

claims.head: The Predators kill penalties far better than the Maple Leafs
claims.body: The Predators are around the middle of the league for the penalty kill, at the airtight end; the Maple Leafs are one of the league’s worst, at the leaky end. Expect that gap to show.
claims.gist: The Predators and the Maple Leafs sit at opposite ends for penalty kill.
claims.call: The Predators’ penalty kill allows less per 60 than the Maple Leafs’.

TOR.head: Close, but Nashville has the slight edge
TOR.body: Nashville has controlled the play far better over recent games and Toronto has home ice. Toronto can tip it if they pounce on loose pucks.

NSH.head: Nashville has a slight edge
